title: Sapient
summary: Self-custody Chrome extension wallet for Tari Ootle mainnet and testnets. November 17, 2026: the official Chrome Web Store lists version 0.10.0, updated today. The creator website confirms mainnet support and network switching; the store overview still contains older testnet-only copy. The owner previously confirmed the wallet is live on mainnet. Use the official store for the currently available extension. This review did not install the extension or submit a wallet transfer. The retained recording is historical source footage.
cardSummary: Manage Ootle mainnet accounts, private transfers and app approvals with the Sapient browser extension.
